summary: **In the matter of: Support Properties Private Limited (SPPL)** . Adani Corporate House, Shantigram Near Vaishno Devi Circle, S.G Highway Khodiyar, Ahmedabad ** .Petitioner** - _(a) Permit the Petitioner to withdraw/ cancel its relinquishment letter dated 22.01.2025 (communicated via email dated 11.02.2025) of its 700 MW of GNA/ Connectivity, and allow continuation of the GNA granted to the Petitioner vide letter dated 24.10.2024;_ - _(c) Pass any other or further orders as it may deem fit to this Commission in the facts and circumstances of the present case._ - _(a) Allow the present application thereby restraining the Respondent/ CTUIL from taking any coercive actions, including encashment of Bank Guarantees furnished by the Petitioner, till the pendency of the accompanying petition; and_ - _(b) Pass any other or further orders as it may deem fit to this Hon’ble Commission in the facts and circumstances of the present case._ - _(a) Allow the present application thereby urgently listing the present petition for hearing; and_ - _(b) Pass any other or further orders as it may deem fit to this Hon’ble Commission in the facts and circumstances of the present case._ - (d) Accordingly, the Petitioner vide letter dated 22.01.2025 (the same was sent with an email sent on 11.02.2025 and a hard copy of the same was sent on 19.02.2025) to the Respondent sought to relinquish the GNA granted to it, which was accepted by the said Respondent on 20.03.2025. In view of such relinquishment of GNA, CTUIL proceeded to invoke the encashment of Bank Guarantees furnished by SPPL. - (j) Petitioner also wrote to the Ministry of Power (MOP) on 09.04.2025. The matter was discussed in a meeting dated 09.04.2025 under the chairmanship of the Secretary (Power), wherein it was decided to approach this Commission within the next seven working days for clarifications on this issue. Accordingly, the status quo was maintained until CERC discussed the matter. - (k) It is submitted that while there cannot be any levy of relinquishment charges upon the Petitioner in the first place as CTUIL did not suffer any losses, the said Petitioner has 6. Petitioner vide affidavit dated 16.04.2025 has made the following submissions seeking interim relief: - (b) The Petitioner/ Applicant is filing the present application before this Hon’ble commission seeking interim relief, as no coercive actions may be taken by the Respondent, including encashment of Bank Guarantees, till the pendency of the present Petition before this Hon’ble commission, as the same will precipitate the matter and will cause severe losses to the Petitioner. 7. During the hearing, learned Counsel for the Petitioner presented the case through verbal arguments. CTUIL sought liberty to file a reply in the matter. After considering submissions of parties, the Petition was admitted, and Respondents were directed to file a reply within two weeks. The Commission further directed that: - _“(c) The status-quo in regard to the Bank Guarantees submitted by the Petitioners shall continue till the next date of hearing._ - (b) The Petitioner is seeking to retain the already relinquished GNA. It is submitted that, pursuant to the request, CTUIL has already accepted the relinquishment. Once a request for relinquishment of the connectivity is made, the connectivity ceases to exist, and the Petitioner will cease to have any rights associated with it. It is submitted that, if the Petitioner seeks to re-establish such connectivity, it is required to submit a fresh application in accordance with the applicable regulatory framework. In such - 9.The Petitioner vide affidavit dated 16.07.2025 has made a rejoinder to the submission of CTUIL, wherein mainly the following is submitted: - (a) The contentions made by CTUIL in its reply are completely contradictory to its own stand taken in the meeting conducted by MOP dated 09.04.2025, wherein it is in agreement with MOP that there is a regulatory gap in the existing Regulations, while in its reply in the present proceedings, it is contending the opposite, that the regulations are clear and unambiguous. - (h) Petitioner has sought to continue the previously granted GNA. This further demonstrates that no prejudice will be caused to CTUIL if the relief as sought by the Petitioner in the present is granted by this Commission. 10. Learned senior counsel for the Petitioner and the learned counsel for the RespondentCTUIL, made detailed submissions and concluded their respective arguments. Considering their request, the Commission permitted both sides to file their respective written submissions, if any, within a week, with a copy to the other side. The _status quo_ was directed to be maintained regarding the Bank Guarantees submitted by the Petitioner till the outcome of the matter, and the matter was reserved for Order. - 12.The Petitioner vide written submissions dated 24.11.2025 has reiterated submissions already made, the Petitioner has submitted as under: regulatory prescription that is not available under the GNA Regulations, and CTUIL’s actions shall be guided by the provisions under the Regulations notified by this Commission or Orders of this Commission. _(c) Relinquishment charges received under clauses (a) and (b) of this Regulation shall be used for reducing Monthly Transmission Charges under the Sharing Regulations._ 24. We have taken note of the aforesaid arguments of parties, the stipulations under Regulations 25.1 of 2022 GNA Regulations are unequivocal and mandate encashment of Conn BGs, in case GNA is relinquished prior to effectiveness. 31. The Petition 451MP2025, along with IA 36/2025, is disposed of in terms of the above.
title: Petition under Section 79, including 79 (1)(c), 79 (1)(f) and 79 (1)(k) of the Electricity Act, 2003, seeking continuation of its GNA/ Connectivity of 700 MW. The Petitioner is also seeking consequent directions upon the Respondent/ CTUIL to consider Connectivity Bank Guarantees already furnished by the Petitioner with respect to its GNA applications dated 30.05.2024 to 22.06.2024 as sufficient for the purpose of such continuation, with no requirement to submit fresh Connectivity Bank Guarantees. Support Properties Private Limited
